candidates.violated_requirement: The shift register should shift in the input 'a' to the least significant bit (LSB) position, but instead shifts it to the most significant bit (MSB) position. This causes the pattern matching to fail when the correct sequence is shifted in.
candidates.spec_basis: Shift Register Behavior: On every positive edge of the clock, if rst_n is asserted (logic 1), the input a should be shifted into the least significant bit (LSB) of the shift register a_tem, and the previous bits should shift left by one position.
